integrity: The 3054-face universe and all 13568 Hasse incidences are exhaustively checked. Exact integral Morse boundary and signed unit pivot, rather than mod-two ranks alone, establish the homotopy type.
scientific_limitations: Specific sixteen-vertex four-cube and two-independence parameter only; noncanonical integral homotopy splitting; possible unindexed prior computation; no independent scientific audit.
title: Mixed-dimensional integral homotopy of the two-independence complex of the four-cube
